summary: Configured node1 to run /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15 via root's crontab, appending output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. The script file was found broken (contained leftover heredoc/setup artifacts instead of valid shell) and was rewritten to a correct, executable printf-based script. Verified the cron entry, script execution, and log append behavior before and after a full node1 reboot, confirming persistence via a changed boot_id.
actions_performed: Inspected existing script, cron state, and log file on node1
Rewrote /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance which had corrupted content (leftover heredoc/setup lines) into a valid executable shell script, set root:root ownership and 0755 perms
Verified crontab installation and simulated a run to confirm log creation/append
Captured baseline boot_id, cron active status, crontab content, and log content
Issued systemctl reboot on node1, acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Confirmed boot_id changed, proving an actual restart occurred
Verified post-restart: cron active, crontab entry intact, script intact/executable, log content persisted, and a fresh script execution appended a new successful log line

evidence.requirement: Script /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance exists, is valid/executable, and runs successfully
evidence.summary: Found the script corrupted with leftover heredoc artifacts; rewrote it to a valid, executable (0755, root:root) script and confirmed it runs and prints expected output with exit 0.

evidence.requirement: Cron job scheduled at 02:15 daily to run the script and retain output in /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
evidence.summary: Installed root crontab entry '15 2 * * * /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1', verified via crontab -l, and confirmed via a simulated run that output is correctly appended to the log file.
Captured boot_id (1e0cb179...), cron active status, crontab entry presence, and existing log content prior to reboot.

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Issued systemctl reboot (ack returned before disconnect), observed connection timeout while rebooting, then reconnected and confirmed boot_id changed to 9fe03622..., proving an actual restart.

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of cron scheduling, script, and log data
evidence.summary: After restart, verified cron service active, crontab entry intact, script intact and executable, prior log content preserved, and a fresh manual run appended a new successful execution line to the log.
